_comment: Repeats the gate tools/art-repeats.py allows, each with the reason a person wrote. A RATCHET, not an amnesty: the key carries the exact measurement, so a sprite that is redrawn loses its exemption and has to earn a new one. A stale entry - one naming a repeat no longer in the tree - is itself reported as a problem, because an exemption that outlives its subject is a lie about the drawing.
_ruled: The owner saw sixteen sprites containing the same pixels twice on 2026-09-03, boxed, and ruled: redraw all. None was redrawn - his own instruction was to use the seed for local variation instead, as lightly as possible. All sixteen cleared. The last of them, stream_edge, was impossible until the four season colours he ruled in the same evening gave the cool petal the lighter neighbour it had never had.
